notes:
## Better
- Problem reports leave out more personal details: user names with accents, the summary file, lower-case VINs, the licence name and the remote car address.
- Flash assistant: E-Sys no longer stutters every second when the backup folder is on a slow or sleeping drive, and "I checked the job" is cleared for a new job.
- SVT Compare no longer shows a module as changed when only the order of its parts differs.
- Service and Functions open only once, even on a double click.
- If the launcher cannot open, it says so and closes, instead of blocking every later start.
- A maximised launcher comes back maximised.
